$comment: The ONE version of every cargo tool CI installs via taiki-e/install-action (#4406). Each workflow step writes `tool: <name>@<version>` with exactly this version; scripts/internal/check-cargo-tool-pins.mjs fails on an unpinned tool or a version that differs from this file. Dependabot cannot bump these: see docs/contributing.md -> 'Cargo tool versions'.
